{{Quote|Are you looking for the handmaiden Jaanie? That's me!|Jaanie|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Jaanie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] for [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Jaanie was wanted by [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mal Sikander]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was pursued by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. To help the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] and her handmaiden, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with rescuing Jaanie and bringing her back safely to the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Da Naboo biggen, Queen Kylantha, be needin shesan handmaiden brought here. De Empire biggen, Sikander, be wantin to pune-ish da girl. Yousa hep save shesan?"<br />"Who is this handmaiden?"<br />"Shesa culled Jaanie an shesa good friend to da Naboo biggen. Yousa hep shesan?|Boss Rugor Nass and a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] by the name of Jaanie served [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="SWG" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mal Sikander]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] and [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] pursued Jaanie with the intent to punish her. The [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] feared for Jaanie's welfare, and wished to see her brought to safety.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
As a show of goodwill to the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo people]] and their [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], Boss Rugor Nass enlisted a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find the missing handmaiden and bring her back safely to the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]], a sacred monument in the [[Lasay Swamp]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In the search for Jaanie, the spacer was attacked by a [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper squad leader]] and three other [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. However, the spacer successfully fought off and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the four of them. When the spacer reached Jaanie, she thanked the individual, and warned that ISB agents were still after her. Nevertheless, no harm befell the endangered handmaiden. Thanks to the spacer's help, Jaanie was uneventfully escorted back to Boss Nass in the safe confines of the Sacred Place.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm grateful for your help. You should know that ISB agents have been sent to find me.|Jaanie to her rescuer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Jaanie had fair skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Her [[Mouth/Legends|lips]] were covered with blue colored makeup. As a wanted fugitive of the Galactic Empire, Jaanie expressed gratitude when a spacer came to rescue her. According to Boss Nass, she was a good friend of Kylantha, the ruling monarch of Naboo.<ref name="SWG" />

==Equipment==
While she was on the run from the Empire, Jaanie wore a light gray short sleeve [[shirt]] with a blue wrapped [[Clothing/Legends|skirt]] and light gray [[Belt/Legends|waistband]]. She also wore gray dress shoes and [[Silver/Legends|silver]] colored [[Bracelet/Legends|bangles]] on her left [[Limb/Legends|forearm]]. Her personal arsenal consisted of multiple types of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]], including a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]], a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Striker projectile pistol]], and an [[SE-14 blaster pistol]]. Secondary weapons included two versions of the [[DH-17 blaster carbine/Legends|DH-17 carbine]], as well as a snubnosed version known as the [[DH-17 short carbine]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Yousa failin, yousa spek? Poor girl! Dis be bombin!|Boss Rugor Nass to players who failed to rescue Jaanie|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Jaanie was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was included in the second [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] given by [[W:c:swg:Boss Nass|Boss Nass]], an NPC located at the [[W:c:swg:Gungan Sacred Place|Gungan Sacred Place]] on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[W:c:swg:Naboo|Naboo]]. In the quest, players were instructed by Boss Nass to find Jaanie and escort her back safely. Completing the quest would earn the player 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Although the player could choose not to do Boss Nass' quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG" /> Because Jaanie spawned under the generic "mission_plainsfolk" template,<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesAED}} directory tree files and source data</ref> her graphical appearance was identical to other NPCs in the game, such as [[Deehan]]. At some point during the game's early lifespan, Boss Nass' quests were deactivated, effectively removing Jaanie from [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']].<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], Boss Nass' content was revamped to become a part of the expansive [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]] series.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
